Descriptor: A red envelope backed by a blue and green gradient background. Surrounding the envelope are six small black dots labelled 1-6, as well as overlapped & angled white informational text. The bottom of the plane is framed by white "Nederland" small text.
Story: A stamp issued in the Netherlands for Letter Writing Day. Designed by Montse Hernandez i Sala.

Descriptor: Center figure is an weightlifting Olympian athlete in a red leotard & red sneakers. The plane is framed by various informational text, including the Olympic logo in the bottom right corner.
Story: A stamp issued in Monaco for the 1964 Toyko Olympics.

Descriptor: A featured blue rectangle framed to the left of the plane. There is a featured "CARE" logo in the top left of the blue rectangle, as well as a graphic illustration of a soybean plant. There rest of the plane is filled with various informational text.
Story: A stamp issued in Costa Rica for the 20th anniversary of CARE, a humanitarian organization.

Descriptor: The stamp is comprised of one framed graphic. The entire graphic has an outer ornamental patterned frame, while the center image is of three lions: one in the middle, facing the viewer, and the other two on either side facing outwards.
Story: A stamp issued in India for official "Service", or government correspondence, featuring the Lion Capital of Asoka (Asoka Pillar).

Descriptor: An humorous illustration of two postal workers on a "magic carpet," and being chased through the sky by a dog with its own "magic carpet." Featuring a city skyline in the background, as well as informational text below the image frame.
Story: A stamp issued in Australia as part of the "Living Together" series.

Descriptor: Featured painted image of a shoebill stork. Below the image is informational text.
Story: A stamp issued in Zambia to commemorate the native shoebill stork.

Descriptor: A featured framed image of an ambiguous 3D, geometric structure, all situated within a space-like scene. The stamp has informational text above and below this framed image.
Story: A stamp issued in Guinea-Bissau for their Cosmonautica series, primarily featuring a telecommunications satellite.

Descriptor: Featuring a center red cross symbol on a white background, framed by a light red patterned frame. The patterned frame is filled with informational text on all four sides.
Story: A stamp issued in Sweden to commemorate 80 years of the Swedish Red Cross.

Descriptor: A center image of a Little Pygmy Possum in nature. There is informational text above and below the image.
Story: A stamp issued in Australia as part of the "Threatened Species" series.

Descriptor: A featured painting of a Shag (seabird) on a cliffside overlooking other Shags in the sea, all with a background landscape of mountains meeting the sea.
Story: A stamp issued in the Isle of Man as a celebration of the specific region on the island, the Calf of Man.

Descriptor: A featured portrait of Sierra Leone's former president Siaka Stevens, with a vivid coral background.
Story: A stamp issued in Sierra Leone to commemorate former president Siaka Stevens.

Descriptor: This triangle stamp features a graphic map background, as well as the formal crossing of the Venezuelan and Brazilian flags. There is informational text below the flags, across the bottom edge of the frame.
Story: A stamp issued in Venezuela to commemorate the "Golden Road" highway that connects El Dorado, Venezuela to Santa Elena de Uairen on the border to Brazil.

Descriptor: Features a framed image of doctors in an operating room, surrounded by informational text.
Story: A stamp issued in Venezuela as part of the "Pay Your Taxes" series, as paid for by the Ministry of Finance.

Descriptor: Features a singular Japanese Spider Crab interacting with the frame. There's informational text in the gaps of space around it.
Story: A stamp issued in Monaco as part of the "Fauna and Flora" series.

Descriptor: Features a dual image, with working hands at the bottom half of the frame and a book opening in the arrangement of a swirl in the top half.
Story: A stamp issued in Canada as part of the "Traditional Trades" series.

Descriptor: Featuring a birds-eye view of a rowing team on the water. There's informational text overlapping the image at the bottom of the frame.
Story: A stamp issued by Grenada to commemorate the 7th Pan American Games in Mexico City.

Descriptor: Featuring a minimal green leaf graphic against a tan background. There's informational text surrounding the graphic on every edge but the base.
Story: A stamp issued in Italy as part of the CEPT "Europa" series.

Descriptor: This stamp is primarily featuring dark red printed patterns that frame informational text.
Story: A stamp issued in China, as printed by the Shanghai Printing press of the Dah Tung Book Company.

Descriptor: Featuring a green and purple colorway, a centered portrait of Abraham Lincoln is framed by informational text.
Story: A stamp issued by Honduras to commemorate the 150th birthday of Abraham Lincoln.

Descriptor: Featuring a central image of a Titoki plant native to New Zealand. Informational text is informational text is overlapping and surrounding the image.
Story: A stamp issued by New Zealand as part of the "Plant and Flower" series.

Descriptor: Featuring a central image of a Chlorinda Hairstreak butterfly. Informational text is sitting below and above the butterfly on the frame's edges.
Story: A stamp issued by Australia to commemorate the Chlorinda Hairstreak butterfly, as part of the butterfly stamp series.

Descriptor: Features a dual image, with a portrait of King George VI on the top left and a landscape of the Imperial College of Tropical Agriculture on the central right of the frame.
Story: A stamp issued by Trinidad & Tobago to commemorate the Imperial College of Tropical Agriculture.

Descriptor: Features a monochromatic colorway, with a central posed female figure in front of a rising/setting sun horizon in the back.
Story: A stamp issued by France to commemorate the allegorical Le Semeuse (the Sower). Designed by Oscar Roty.

Descriptor: Features a landscape representation of the Palace of the Lost City in the North West Province.
Story: A stamp issued by South Africa commemorating tourism in South Africa & the Lost City.

Descriptor: Features the painting "Spring Morning in the Han Palace" by Qiu Yang (Ming Dynasty).
Story: A stamp issued by the Republic of China (Taiwan) as part of the "Ancient Chinese Paintings" series.

Descriptor: Features a central graphic of a tree atop soil within an hourglass, with the soil falling down below. There's informational text above and below the framed image.
Story: A stamp issued by Australia as part of an environmental protection series, in an environmental effort of conserving soil.

Descriptor: Central graphic of a canadian maple leaf in a half-tone bitmap. Informational text is above and below the graphic along the frame edges.
Story: A stamp issued by Canada as part of the "Canada Definitives" series.

Descriptor: Central illustration of a rocketship taking off, framed to the bottom of the plane. There's informational text above, within, and below the framed image.
Story: A stamp issued by Honduras to commemorate the age of space travel (inspired by the 1969 moon landing).

Descriptor: Features a central graphic of a Futbol cleat in action, while the background is composed of a graphic stripe pattern & framed by a bold magenta. There's informational text above and below the graphic along the edges of the frame.
Story: A stamp issued by Guatemala commemorating the XIII Central American and Caribbean Games held in Medellin.

Descriptor: Features an illustrative landscape of Pagoda Hill, sitting above a graphic of a red open book. There's informational text along the top and bottom of the plane.
Story: A stamp issued by the People's Republic of China commemorating the 50th anniversary of Mao Zedong's talks at the Yan'an Forum.
